Sam Patel: hey team :wave: I'm starting Monday — quick Q: where do I find the product playbooks and team templates in Notion? also need edit access for onboarding docs. who should I ping? thanks!

Maya Chen: welcome Sam! :tada: main docs live under `Company / Product / Playbooks` (workspace: Redwood Inference). shortlink: https://redwood.in/docs/playbooks. For edit access we usually ask the page owners or file a docs-perms request. I can grant editor on most onboarding pages if you need it quickly.

Ali Gomez: hey Sam — if you want to modify a template, duplicate the template and move the copy into your team space. owners are listed at the very top of each template page. tell me which template and I'll add you.

Devon Lee: engineering runbooks are under `Engineering / Runbooks`. owners = eng-runbooks. For permissions, use the perms form: https://redwood.in/forms/docs-perms (choose "edit" and list the pages).

Sam Patel: thanks! which Notion workspace do i use? 'Redwood Inference' or something else?

Maya Chen: Redwood Inference workspace. if you don't see pages, try logging out/in to SSO or send a screenshot here. also check the invite email matches your SSO address.

Ali Gomez: quick steps to duplicate a template: ```1) Open template page 2) click ••• (top-right) 3) Duplicate 4) Move to /Team space 5) Share -> Add editors``` I'll add you to the onboarding checklist now.

docbot: Ticket #12345 created for Sam Patel (docs-perms). Owner: Ali Gomez. ETA: 2 business days.

Maya Chen: done — gave editor on "New hire checklist" and "Product playbook — onboarding" :white_check_mark:

Sam Patel: got it, can see the pages now. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

Devon Lee: ping me if you want to pair on the dev environment setup tomorrow.
